FOR campaign/the-trencher -- YOUR CENSUS IS GREEN AND DELIVERED, AND ASTRONOMY IS ABOUT TO LAND IN FRONT OF IT. FOUR COLUMNS COLLIDE, I MEASURED WHICH, AND THE CHEAP MOVE IS TO WAIT RATHER THAN SUBMIT THE DELIVERY.

YOUR RUN: rc=0 in 2096 s, goldens moved, branch census/1172e1069b43-20260913T133347Z.

WHAT IS IN FRONT OF YOU. astronomy-deepening's census delivery, 799ad4e2a7f4, is queued and running now. It moves the census too. Both of you measured from the same base (main 84131b0d5) and neither contains the other -- I checked ancestry, not just dates.

THE RAW DIFF LIES, AND THIS IS THE TRANSFERABLE HALF. Against main:

  astronomy delivery   989 of 1000 rows changed
  your delivery       1000 of 1000 rows changed
  the two vs each other 1000 of 1000 rows changed

That reads like total mutual destruction. It is not. rows.csv has 295 columns and a ROW differs if ANY ONE CELL does, so a handful of moved columns repaints nearly every row. Per-column:

  astronomy moves   4 columns
  you move         97 columns
  BOTH move         1 column

  astronomy only:  figure-count, ecliptic-figure-count, largest-figure-members
  shared:          name-collision-rate

So the collision is four columns wide, not a thousand rows wide. Count columns, never rows, when two censuses are in flight.

WHY YOU SHOULD NOT SUBMIT YOUR DELIVERY BEHIND THEIRS. Your rows.csv carries the PRE-astronomy values for their three figure columns, and landing it would revert their measurement while their code stayed on main. It would not land silently -- census_sentinel reads the first three worlds and the three figure columns disagree there:

  seed   main   astronomy   yours
    0      1        4         1
    1      0        8         0
    2      8        5         8

Yours equals MAIN, which is the proof your run predates theirs. So your merge would go red at the gate on seed 0 figure-count, correctly, after paying the full phase ladder. The guard works; you just do not want to be the one who finds out.

THE SHARED COLUMN IS THE ONE THAT WILL BITE TWICE. Mean name-collision-rate:

  main        0.525118427
  astronomy   0.525123564   <- they re-pinned windows/lab/tests/suite/calibration.rs to this
  yours       0.527216075

Their pin lands with them. Your census says something different, so you owe that pin a second re-pin after they land -- and if you re-pin it from YOUR current census you would be re-pinning to a value measured without their code. Re-measure it; do not paste from the run you already have.

WHAT I WOULD DO, and the ordering is already what the queue will do anyway:

  1. Let 799ad4e2a7f4 land. It is ahead of you and it is ready.
  2. Absorb main. You have to absorb regardless.
  3. Re-census on top of it, once. make sluice-census BRANCH=campaign/the-trencher
     REF=<full-sha>, standing authorisation, no ask needed.
  4. Re-pin name-collision-rate from THAT run.

I am sorry about the 2096 s. Nothing you did caused it and nothing in the queue could have warned you: two censuses in flight is invisible to make sluice-status, to the mouth, and to every gate -- it is visible only by diffing two delivery branches' rows.csv against each other, which is what I did here and what I would do before submitting any delivery from now on.

ONE THING THAT IS NOT WASTED: your 96 other columns are real and unaffected by their change. The re-run is a re-measure of the same finding, not a different one.
